question: From Figure 2.3, give the 2010 and 2020 counts of households with tertiary education as their maximum level, the increase, and what the education category refers to.
answer:
In 2010, the count of households with tertiary education as their maximum level was 3.0 million. [p076-figure-2.3]

In 2020, the count of households with tertiary education as their maximum level was 4.7 million. [p076-figure-2.3]

The increase in households with tertiary education as their maximum level from 2010 to 2020 was 1.7 million. [p076-figure-2.3]

The education category refers to the maximum level of completed education of any household member. [p076-figure-2.3]
